exampleSentences: Gradient attribution is the cheapest way to build a saliency map.
The gradient of the output with respect to the input is the saliency score.
Smoothed variants such as integrated gradients reduce the noise.
The method needs a forward and a backward pass per sample.

defCn: 提示，输入给语言模型的指令与上下文文本。
defEn: The instruction and context text that is given to a language model.
exampleSentence: A precise prompt often matters more than a bigger model.
exampleSentences: A precise prompt often matters more than a bigger model.
Keep the task description, the format and the examples in the prompt.
Prompt wording changes the output even for the same model.
Long prompts should be cached to save cost and latency.

defCn: 检索增强生成，先检索资料再让模型基于资料生成回答。
defEn: A pattern that retrieves documents first and grounds the answer in them.
codeExample:
docs = retriever.search(question, k=5)
answer = llm.build_prompt(docs, question)
exampleSentence: RAG grounds the answer in your own data instead of the model memory.
exampleSentences: RAG grounds the answer in your own data instead of the model memory.
The retriever and the generator are tuned independently.
Adding source citations to the prompt reduces hallucination.
Chunk size and overlap strongly affect the answer quality.

defCn: 幻觉，模型生成看似合理但实际错误或不存在的内容。
defEn: When a model produces fluent output that is factually wrong or unsupported.
exampleSentence: Hallucination remains the biggest risk in production assistants.
exampleSentences: Hallucination remains the biggest risk in production assistants.
Grounding the model in retrieved documents reduces the problem.
Citation checks catch many unsupported claims automatically in production.
Uncertainty warnings help users calibrate how much they should trust it.

defCn: 智能体，能自主规划步骤并调用工具完成任务的模型程序。
defEn: A program that lets a model plan steps and call tools to reach a goal.
exampleSentence: An agent turns a single prompt into a multi step plan.
exampleSentences: An agent turns a single prompt into a multi step plan.
The loop of think, act and observe defines most agent frameworks.
Tool errors must be recoverable or the agent loop ends early.
Every tool call needs a clear schema and a timeout.

defCn: 基于人类反馈的强化学习，用人类偏好来微调语言模型。
defEn: Reinforcement learning from human feedback used to align a model with preferences.
exampleSentence: RLHF is the standard way to make a base model follow instructions.
exampleSentences: RLHF is the standard way to make a base model follow instructions.
The reward model is trained on ranked human comparisons first.
The policy is then optimised with a KL penalty to the reference model.
Good reward data matters more than the algorithm choice.

defCn: 模型漂移，模型随时间推移表现下降的现象。
defEn: The gradual degradation of a deployed model as the world changes.
exampleSentence: Model drift is the normal fate of every deployed model.
exampleSentences: Model drift is the normal fate of every deployed model.
Concept drift and data drift are two different causes of it.
A scheduled retraining cycle is the usual mitigation.
Tracking a leading indicator catches it before the business metric drops.

defCn: 数据漂移，输入特征的分布随时间发生变化。
defEn: A change in the distribution of the input features over time.
exampleSentence: Data drift happens even when nothing in the model changed.
exampleSentences: Data drift happens even when nothing in the model changed.
Seasonality alone can produce a large data drift signal.
It is easier to monitor than concept drift because labels are not needed.
Data drift does not always hurt accuracy, so verify before reacting.

defCn: 概念漂移，特征与标签之间的关系随时间发生改变。
defEn: A change in the relationship between inputs and the target over time.
exampleSentence: Concept drift is invisible in the input distribution alone.
exampleSentences: Concept drift is invisible in the input distribution alone.
It is detected through a rising error rate on fresh labelled data.
A change in policy or user behaviour is a typical trigger.
Retraining on recent data is the direct remedy.

defCn: 特征漂移，某个具体特征的取值分布随时间偏移。
defEn: The distribution of one particular feature changing relative to training.
exampleSentence: Feature drift is measured per column to localise the problem.
exampleSentences: Feature drift is measured per column to localise the problem.
A single drifted column can break an otherwise stable model.
The population stability index is the standard threshold statistic.
Per feature thresholds avoid one noisy column raising every alarm.

defCn: 训练流水线，把数据准备、训练与评估串成可重跑的流程。
defEn: A repeatable workflow that chains data preparation, training and evaluation.
exampleSentence: A training pipeline should run end to end with one command.
exampleSentences: A training pipeline should run end to end with one command.
Every stage should write its outputs somewhere another stage can find them.
Manual steps in a pipeline are the ones that quietly break.
The pipeline configuration belongs in version control with the code.

defCn: 可复现运行，给定相同代码与数据得到相同结果的训练执行。
defEn: A training execution that yields the same result when repeated with the same inputs.
exampleSentence: A reproducible run is the baseline for any serious experiment.
exampleSentences: A reproducible run is the baseline for any serious experiment.
Seed, data version and code commit are the minimum metadata.
Non deterministic GPU kernels are a common source of drift.
Attach the environment lock file to the run record.

defCn: 数据版本管理，为数据集编号并追踪每个模型使用的数据版本。
defEn: Giving datasets immutable versions and recording which version trained each model.
exampleSentence: Data versioning makes it possible to rebuild a model exactly.
exampleSentences: Data versioning makes it possible to rebuild a model exactly.
Point in time snapshots avoid mixing old and new rows.
Large datasets usually need content addressed storage rather than copies.
The data version belongs in the model registry entry.

defCn: 数据血缘，记录数据从来源到模型之间的加工链路。
defEn: The recorded chain of transformations that produced a dataset.
exampleSentence: Data lineage answers where a surprising number actually came from.
exampleSentences: Data lineage answers where a surprising number actually came from.
Every transformation should be a node in the lineage graph.
Lineage makes debugging a bad training row much faster.
It is also required for audit in regulated domains.

defCn: 数据标注，为训练数据赋予正确标签的过程。
defEn: The process of attaching ground truth labels to raw data samples.
exampleSentence: Data labeling usually costs more than the compute used for training.
exampleSentences: Data labeling usually costs more than the compute used for training.
Clear guidelines and a calibration round improve label quality.
Inter annotator agreement is the usual way to measure quality.
The same guidelines must be versioned with the dataset.

defCn: 标注工具，供人工标注者给样本打标签的交互式软件。
defEn: Software that lets human annotators label samples efficiently.
exampleSentence: A good annotation tool shortens the time per label dramatically.
exampleSentences: A good annotation tool shortens the time per label dramatically.
Keyboard shortcuts and active learning queues boost throughput.
The tool should log every change for auditability.
Quality checks sample a fraction of labels for review.

defCn: 主动学习，挑选模型最不确定的样本优先送去标注。
defEn: A labelling strategy that queries the samples the model is least sure about.
exampleSentence: Active learning cuts the number of labels needed for a target quality.
exampleSentences: Active learning cuts the number of labels needed for a target quality.
Uncertain samples carry the most information for the model.
A small random batch is often kept to avoid a biased selection.
The strategy works best when the error budget is limited.

defCn: 弱监督，用噪声规则或启发式标签代替人工标注。
defEn: Using noisy heuristic or programmatic labels instead of human annotations.
exampleSentence: Weak supervision produces training data faster than human labelling.
exampleSentences: Weak supervision produces training data faster than human labelling.
Several weak sources can be combined with a label model.
The estimated accuracy is usually far below human labelling quality.
It is a good way to bootstrap a cold labelled dataset.

defCn: 人类反馈，人工对模型输出给出的评价与修正。
defEn: Evaluation or correction of model outputs supplied by people.
exampleSentence: Human feedback is the most reliable signal for alignment.
exampleSentences: Human feedback is the most reliable signal for alignment.
Annotators pick between two candidate answers rather than writing one.
Clear rubrics make the preferences much more consistent.
Sampling diverse and hard cases improves the signal per label.

defCn: 偏好数据，记录人类对候选答案排序偏好的训练样本。
defEn: Training data that records how people rank competing model outputs.
exampleSentence: Preference data is the raw material for a reward model.
exampleSentences: Preference data is the raw material for a reward model.
Each pair contains one accepted and one rejected answer.
The quality of the guidelines determines the quality of the data.
Models trained on it usually refuse more and follow instructions better.

defCn: 奖励模型，学习给候选回答打分的判别式模型。
defEn: A model trained to score candidate answers by human preference.
exampleSentence: The reward model turns raw preferences into a scalar score.
exampleSentences: The reward model turns raw preferences into a scalar score.
It is usually a smaller model with a single output head.
Over-optimising against it can easily create reward hacking behaviour.
The reference model and the reward model share the same base.

defCn: 策略模型，强化学习或对齐训练中被直接优化的生成模型。
defEn: The generative model that is directly optimised during policy optimisation.
exampleSentence: During alignment the policy model is the one that actually serves users.
exampleSentences: During alignment the policy model is the one that actually serves users.
A KL penalty keeps the policy close to the reference model.
Sampling from the policy generates the completions to be scored.
The policy is exported for deployment after training.

defCn: 对齐，让模型行为符合人类意图与价值观的过程。
defEn: The process of making model behaviour match human intent and values.
exampleSentence: Alignment is what makes a base model usable as an assistant.
exampleSentences: Alignment is what makes a base model usable as an assistant.
Alignment work covers helpfulness, harmlessness, honesty and refusal behaviour.
It needs both automated evaluation and human review.
Alignment is not finished when the training run ends.

defCn: 上下文窗口，模型一次能处理的 token 数量上限。
defEn: The maximum number of tokens a model can attend to in one pass.
exampleSentence: The context window limits both prompt size and answer length.
exampleSentences: The context window limits both prompt size and answer length.
Longer windows cost more memory because attention is quadratic.
Prompts beyond the window must be truncated or chunked.
Models advertised with long windows are often tested on short documents.

defCn: 结构化输出，让模型返回符合固定模式的数据。
defEn: Constraining the model output to follow a defined schema such as JSON.
exampleSentence: Structured output removes the need to parse free form text.
exampleSentences: Structured output removes the need to parse free form text.
Schema constrained decoding guarantees the shape of the result.
It also reduces the tokens spent on brackets and prose.
Validation of the parsed object still belongs in your code.

defCn: 工具调用，让模型请求执行外部函数或接口。
defEn: The mechanism where a model emits a call to an external function or API.
exampleSentence: Tool calling turns a language model into a useful application.
exampleSentences: Tool calling turns a language model into a useful application.
The model proposes the arguments and your code executes the call.
Every tool needs a precise description and a strict argument schema.
Results must be returned to the model so it can continue reasoning.

defCn: 批量推理，把多个请求合并成一次前向计算以提升吞吐。
defEn: Combining many requests into a single model call to increase throughput.
exampleSentence: Batch inference is how serving keeps the accelerator utilisation high.
exampleSentences: Batch inference is how serving keeps the accelerator utilisation high.
The batch window trades a little latency for much higher throughput.
Requests with the same input length batch together most efficiently.
Offline scoring jobs naturally form very large batches.

defCn: 在线推理，对线上实时请求即时返回模型预测。
defEn: Serving predictions synchronously to live user requests.
exampleSentence: Online inference has a strict latency budget to protect.
exampleSentences: Online inference has a strict latency budget to protect.
The service is usually deployed as a container behind a load balancer.
Caching frequent results can absorb a large share of the traffic.
Fallback behaviour matters when the model server is unavailable.

defCn: 训练-服务偏差，线上特征计算与训练时不一致导致的问题。
defEn: A mismatch between how features are computed in training and in production.
exampleSentence: Training-serving skew is a common cause of a mysteriously bad online score.
exampleSentences: Training-serving skew is a common cause of a mysteriously bad online score.
Even a small difference in a preprocessing step can hurt a lot.
A shared feature pipeline is the usual fix.
Parity tests catch the problem before the model reaches production.

defCn: 特征一致性，训练与线上得到相同特征值的保证。
defEn: The guarantee that a feature has the same value in training and in serving.
exampleSentence: Feature parity tests belong in the release checklist of every model.
exampleSentences: Feature parity tests belong in the release checklist of every model.
Time dependent features are the usual source of mismatch.
A parity test compares values row by row for a sample of traffic.
Failing parity should block the release automatically inside the pipeline.
